mostWorthwhile.text: Following the pillars into surviving clumps and then a new knot gave their journey a clear payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Gathering gas in the tail was less engaging because it established a location without yet resolving a goal.

surprise.text: The nursery outflow mixed with gas from the earlier galactic crossing, giving the resulting stream more than one origin.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the combinations followed the gas and clumps through their surroundings.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what becomes of the dense knot; its formation gives the next stage a tangible starting point.
